insight: Started at MIT; raised a $2.8M seed in 2021 backed by General Catalyst and Dorm Room Fund.
name: RemNote
tagline: Notes, PDF annotation, and spaced-repetition flashcards in one AI study app.
description: RemNote combines outliner notes, PDF annotation, and spaced-repetition flashcards in a single app aimed at students. Its built-in AI generates quiz questions and flashcards in one click from your notes, PDFs, or lecture transcripts, then schedules reviews with a spaced-repetition algorithm. Works offline across web, desktop, and mobile.
edge: Bakes Anki-style spaced repetition directly into the note editor, so making and reviewing flashcards happens inline instead of in a separate app.
pros: Notes, flashcards, and PDFs in one app
cons: AI tools gated to the paid plan
Outliner UI has a learning curve
Best suited to study use cases
